findings.text: Boot processor memory range initialization selects the control interface, discovers variable slot count, prepares internal tables, acquires firmware state, enables caching control, optionally optimizes layout and builds the lookup map, with distinct read only and disabled terminal paths.
Boot processor cache initialization orders range initialization followed by attribute initialization and then conditional per processor cache setup gated by a global caching control indicator.
A global deferred initialization indicator defaults to enabled and is shared through dedicated set and query operations to coordinate early versus rendezvous based cache setup across processors.
Rendezvous handling performs per processor cache setup when deferred mode remains active or the current processor appears offline, otherwise it completes without cache side effects.

Variable slot programming masks out reserved positions when comparing stored base and mask halves against hardware contents and issues hardware updates only on genuine difference, reporting whether any slot changed.
Subsystem enablement is indicated solely by presence of a chosen control interface object, with a null choice meaning disabled regardless of other state.

Boot sequencing moves from address width derived reservation masking through interface choice and count discovery to table preparation and state validation, then either completes optimization and map build or diverges to read only or disabled outcomes.

Cleanup executes substantive work only when the subsystem is active, the required processor capability is present, administrative enablement allows it, and the default type denotes non cached; all other cases leave state unchanged with a no change report.

Cleanup snapshots existing slots, derives merged usable coverage with low megabyte reservation, then either applies explicitly configured granularity settings when lossless or sweeps power of two granularity combinations to discover and install an optimal lossless layout.

Coverage derivation unconditionally includes the lowest megabyte as cached, merges cached snapshots, removes non cached and protected snapshots with firmware bug adjustment below one megabyte when fixed handling is active, excludes an optional high hole, and returns sorted disjoint extents.
Cleanup necessity holds exactly when at least one non cached entry exists and every populated entry is either cached or non cached, with empty slots and other types disqualifying the optimization.
Extent to slot conversion emits successive power of two sized slots limited by both start alignment and remaining length, advancing until the extent is covered or no slots remain.

Hole aware installation aligns pending start and length to granularity, attempts chunk aligned growth, trims growth against the next extent when not final, and when growth overshoots emits cached coverage plus a non cached hole while shrinking unreasonable holes.
Sequential extent intake coalesces low addresses and directly adjacent extents into a pending accumulator and flushes through hole aware installation only upon discontinuity.
Full layout construction clears snapshot storage, feeds all sorted extents through the merging accumulator, flushes trailing pending data, and zeroes any unused trailing slots.

Single slot encoding derives an address mask from processor width and requested size, merges base with type and validity, splits into low and high halves, and represents empty size as an all zero image.
Snapshot utilities convert between kilobyte and frame representations for storage, expand the whole snapshot into encoded slot images, and copy encoded words into global variable state.

Candidate evaluation rebuilds slot state for given chunk and granularity, re derives coverage, records slot usage and coverage delta, invalidates candidates that gain coverage or change identity without loss, and tracks minimal loss per slot count.
Optimal selection bounds spare reservation, favors the smallest slot count achieving zero loss within allowed usage, and returns the earliest matching candidate or a not found signal.
Overlap resolution returns non cached when either side is non cached, write through for mixed cached and write through, the shared value when equal, and non cached for all remaining mismatches.

Map construction coalesces neighboring fixed entries of equal type across decreasing granularities, flags fixed entries as precedence protected, incorporates variable entries, and summarizes counts with optional per entry listing.
Ordered map insertion adds non overlapping prefixes directly, skips fixed or type stable overlaps, replaces conflicting overlap with the resolved effective type, and appends any trailing remainder.
Diagnostic output is provided as a conditional operation that produces informational messages only while a global debug indicator is active and is otherwise inert.
Accounting helpers compute total covered length across an extent array and scale kilobyte quantities into readable units with accompanying unit designation for diagnostic display.
An alternate cleanup entry for configurations without optimization support performs no state changes and unconditionally reports no change.
Observed variable slot state is organized as paired low and high halves for base and mask components, compared with reservation masking and written as coordinated quadruples.

Observed extent descriptors carry start and end frame markers supporting merge subtract and ordering, while conversion context carries pending start and length plus chunk granularity and slot cursor values.

A variable non cached entry overlapping low memory while fixed handling is active indicates a firmware inconsistency, prompting a warning and adjusted subtraction that preserves fixed precedence for the legacy region.
Candidates that enlarge visible coverage or silently alter extent identity are classified invalid and excluded from installation, preventing unintended expansion or reshaping of usable memory.

Fragments rely on symbolic selectors for base and mask registers, capability count and reservation masks, fixed enable flags, and memory type codes for cached write through protected and non cached uses, with numeric encodings defined outside viewed text.
Diagnostic listing helpers report current variable slot populations and candidate evaluation outcomes including granularity settings slot usage and coverage loss with invalid marking.
